prompt: Cinematic brand film, shot on ARRI Alexa 35 mm anamorphic, fine film grain, soft halation, shallow depth of field, slow confident camera moves. Palette: deep ink-blue shadows, warm cream highlights, one acid-lime accent light and tiny coral touches. Real small-business people in their 30s to 50s, work clothes, candid, not models, no suits; alternated with clean glossy abstract 3D in the same palette. Sound: natural room tone and foley only, no music, no speech. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signage, no watermarks, no readable screens.

multi_prompt.prompt: Low-angle close-up. A baker in a flour-dusted apron lifts a wooden tray of golden croissants out of a stone oven; steam and flour drift through a beam of low warm light from the left. Slow push-in. Subject in the lower half, clean dark upper third. Sounds: oven door creak, crackling crust, soft steam hiss.

Medium shot. A hairdresser in a black apron finishes a blow-out; the client turns her head to camera, long auburn hair swinging into a soft glow, and smiles. Coral neon rim light from behind, dark moody salon, slow dolly left. Clean dark wall in the upper third. Sounds: hairdryer winding down, scissors snip, soft laugh.

Abstract 3D render. A row of blank glossy rounded panels in acid lime, cream, coral and ink slides smoothly like a carousel across a dark ink-blue void, reflections on a mirror-black floor, soft studio rim light. Slow lateral camera track. Panels in the lower half, empty dark space above. Sounds: soft glassy chimes, low airy whoosh.

Medium close-up. A young founder in a casual jacket on a rooftop at blue hour, city lights in soft bokeh behind, looks down at a smartphone in both hands with a blank softly glowing screen, then looks up with a confident smile. Slow push-in, lime-green glow on the face. Subject in the lower half, open sky above. Sounds: distant city traffic, soft wind, phone tap.

Abstract calm background. Dark ink-blue void with a soft volumetric acid-lime light beam sweeping slowly across fine floating dust particles, gentle lens bloom, almost empty centre, slow drift. Nothing else. Sounds: soft low airy hum, faint glassy shimmer.
